sources.evidence: The site's own pages Results.html, Problems.html, informe.html and problems.pdf are headed as the 2004 regional contest, though its front pages are of the 2006 edition.

central-america-2005.notes: Source 3 (resultados.php, ITESM Queretaro site) is a results board with no year printed in its visible text; I conclude it is the 2006 edition (belongs to central-america-2006), same file as the page inside the central-america-2004 website copy.

sources.evidence: Table of 140 team rows with columns Rank, Team, Citation, #Solved, Time under The 2005 ACM Mexico and Central America Programming Contest.

central-america-2008.notes: The catalogue knows 11 problems (E Electricity, G Pole Position, H Higgs Boson, I Traveling Shoemaker, J Bora Bora) but this PDF has 7 numbered problems with different names; worth a look. Website copy holds no 2008 results or problems; its seed is the 2009 problem PDF.

sources.evidence: The first page is titled '2008 ACM ICPC Mexico y Centro America' and the agenda, venues, fees and registration pages carry 2008 dates, though the site also holds 2007 and 2009 material.
11-page PDF headed '13th México and Central America ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest 2008' with Problem No. 1 to 7.
